title: Inversion
recall: Inversiya qachon ishlatiladi? Never, Not only, No sooner, Hardly, Only then bilan gap tuzilishini ayt.
formula: inkor ma'noli so'z boshda → yordamchi fe'l + ega: Never have I seen…
Not only did he…, but he also…; No sooner had I… than…; Hardly had I… when…
Only then / Only after / Little did I know / Under no circumstances should you…

pairs.a: I have never seen such a mess.
pairs.b: Never have I seen such a mess.

pairs.a: As soon as I sat down, the phone rang.
pairs.b: No sooner had I sat down than the phone rang.

items.uz: Men hech qachon bunday go'zallikni ko'rmaganman.
en: Never have I seen such beauty.
Never have I seen anything so beautiful.

items.uz: U nafaqat kech qoldi, balki uzr ham so'ramadi.
en: Not only was he late, but he also didn't apologise.
Not only was he late, but he didn't apologize either.

items.uz: Men o'tirishim bilan telefon jiringladi.
en: No sooner had I sat down than the phone rang.
Hardly had I sat down when the phone rang.

items.uz: Men nima bo'lishini umuman bilmasdim.
en: Little did I know what would happen.
Little did I know what was going to happen.

items.uz: Hech qanday holatda bu tugmani bosmang.
en: Under no circumstances should you press this button.
Under no circumstances press this button.

items.uz: Faqat o'shanda men haqiqatni tushundim.
en: Only then did I understand the truth.
Only then did I realise the truth.

items.uz: Kamdan-kam hollarda bunday yaxshi xizmat ko'ramiz.
en: Rarely do we see such good service.
Seldom do we see such good service.

items.uz: U nafaqat ingliz, balki fransuz tilida ham gapiradi.
en: Not only does she speak English, but she also speaks French.
Not only does he speak English, but also French.

items.uz: Uyga kelishim bilan yomg'ir boshlandi.
en: Hardly had I got home when it started to rain.
No sooner had I got home than it started raining.
Hardly had I arrived home when it began to rain.

items.uz: Hayotimda hech qachon bunchalik charchamaganman.
en: Never in my life have I been so tired.

items.uz: Faqat ishni tugatgandan keyin uyga ketishingiz mumkin.
en: Only after finishing the work can you go home.
Only after you finish the work can you go home.

items.uz: Bunday imkoniyat hech qachon boshqa kelmaydi.
en: Never again will such a chance come.
Never will such an opportunity come again.
Never again will you get such a chance.

items.uz: U bu haqda bilishi kerak emas edi.
en: On no account should he know about this.
Under no circumstances should he find out about this.

items.uz: Men uni ko'rishim bilan tanidim.
en: No sooner had I seen him than I recognised him.
Hardly had I seen him when I recognized him.

items.uz: Bunday qiyin imtihonni hech qachon topshirmaganmiz.
en: Never have we taken such a difficult exam.
Never have we had such a hard exam.

items.uz: Kamdan-kam u kechikadi.
en: Rarely is he late.
Seldom is he late.

items.uz: Shundagina men qanchalik xato qilganimni tushundim.
en: Only then did I realise how wrong I had been.
Only then did I understand how wrong I was.

items.uz: U nafaqat aqlli, balki juda mehribon.
en: Not only is she clever, but she is also very kind.
Not only is he smart, but he's also very kind.

items.uz: Men u yerda qancha qolishimizni bilmasdim.
en: Little did I know how long we would stay there.
Little did I know how long we'd be there.

items.uz: Hech qachon bunchalik ko'p odamni bir joyda ko'rmagan edim.
en: Never had I seen so many people in one place.
Never before had I seen so many people in one place.

speak: Hayotingizdagi eng ta'sirli tajriba: Never have I… bilan 3 ta gap.
Bitta voqea: No sooner had… than / Hardly had… when.
O'zingiz haqingizda: Not only… but also… (3 ta).
